title: Transforming Cities: Sustaining São Paulo
summary: This C40 case study describes “Transforming Cities: Sustaining São Paulo,” an urban initiative documented for São Paulo. It is included because it is located in the Global South. intervention.objectives: In São Paulo, Bernadete is part of an initiative that connects farmers to sustainable growing systems and buyers – to feed residents and keep local food culture alive.
intervention.measures:
Bernadete grows native fruits like cambuci on the outskirts of one of the world’s biggest cities. She’s part of an initiative that connects farmers to sustainable growing systems and buyers – to feed the people of São Paulo and keep local food culture alive.
